context: Rockman introduction after Navi installation; script 1 first meeting, script 2 reunion.
voice: Friendly, informal first-person Rockman addressing the player.

units.source:
はじめまして!
ボクは ロックマン
よろしくね!!
units.translation:
처음 만나서 반가워!
난 록맨이야.
잘 부탁해!!
units.notes: First introduction. Preserves three lines and the original page boundary.
Reunion greeting; original key wait remains.

units.source:
キミと またいっしょに
せいかつできるなんて
うれしいよ!!
units.translation:
너와 다시 함께
지낼 수 있다니
정말 기뻐!!
units.notes: Reunion: happy to be living together again. Three source lines retained.
Renewed greeting, not a literal request to repeat an action.
